text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —In my room, watching Kawakami Princess's training footage while pondering.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: How should I have Kawakami Princess run in this debut race... no, in her future races?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —It happened when we set up another mock race.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Mm, mmm...? Huh?
Mmph, mrrgh... Huh!?
choice_data_list: (...Her running form is falling apart again.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The rocket start and flawless form she showed in practice...
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whenever it came to actual "races" like mock races,
the situation where everything fell apart just kept repeating itself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A body suddenly stiffening like un-oiled
machinery. Only the force of each kick increases,
making the stride look labored. The cause is likely...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: ...You're tensing up way too much.
choice_data_list: Tazuna-san!?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? I am terribly sorry!
I did call out and received permission
to enter, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...It seems she was so absorbed in the video
that she was answering absently.
choice_data_list: No, I'm the one who should be sorry

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
No. It's completely understandable to feel uneasy
seeing Kawakami Princess in that state.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Habitually tensing up unnecessary muscles can end up leading to injuries down the line, after all.
choice_data_list: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Besides, injuries weren't the only concern.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: When spirit gets too far ahead and your shoulders tense up unconsciously, your form naturally becomes stiff. If she continues running like that—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—A running form with unnecessary tension
could very well turn into a "bad habit."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: If she enters a big race in her current state, she'll... surely get even more nervous, won't she?
choice_data_list: ...I think so.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Kawakami Princess, simply being able to run in a race had been a long-awaited dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, aiming for the grand stage right now is far too early for her.
If we care about her future..."
choice_data_list: (If I'm truly thinking about what's best for her—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The day of the Make Debut has finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! I'm totally pumped and properly warmed up!
I'm going to knock every last one of you flat right now!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The princess in PriFai was super strong, after all!
I have to become the strongest too!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "At the very least in the Junior Class, you'll run in the Hanshin Juvenile Fillies—Hanshin JF—and blaze through the GⅠ circuit...!"
choice_data_list: (To her, a GⅠ is...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To attain the kind of strength PriFai has.
To compete against powerhouse Umamusume and forge my own
ideal strength... this special stage is necessary for that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And many Junior-class and Classic-class GⅠs
can only be entered during those specific periods.
choice_data_list: （…Even so.）

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Let us hold a strategy meeting!
I shall make whatever you envision a reality!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess looks at me with eyes full of anticipation. What I am about to tell her may betray those expectations.
choice_data_list: There's something I'd like to discuss regarding after your debut.
There's something I wanted to talk about regarding after your debut.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, it is wonderful that you are so eager, Trainer!
Please, do continue!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her sparkling eyes pierce right through me.
But as the Trainer who shares her dreams……
choice_data_list: I was thinking about what lies "ahead" for us.
I was just thinking about "our future" together.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
From here on... *gulp*,
that means...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...For her to achieve even greater success in the future.
I must convey this determination.
choice_data_list: I don't want to aim for a G1 right now.
I don't want to aim for a G1 right now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
You don't mean aiming for it?
That's... um, well...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Are you saying that... I shouldn't expect to ever become a GⅠ Umamusume?
choice_data_list: No!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
choice_data_list: You're still growing.
Because you're still in the middle of growing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I explain her current challenges to her,
saying that instead of aiming straight for a GⅠ,
we should start by getting her used to racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We could see how she does and enter her, but...
If we make it her goal, we don't want to burden her with
unnecessary pressure like, "I absolutely have to win."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I see, so that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Understood, desu wa!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
For a princess, a tiara is a dream.
After all, it is a princess's crown...
that can only be earned on the highest stage of a GⅠ.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Besides, if competing on the Tiara route
can awaken my dormant power...
it'd be kinda like PreFigh, wouldn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I am who I am!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if I admire PriFigh,
what I'm aiming for is my own ideal princess!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: So if you say it is for my sake, Trainer, I shall accomplish it, no matter how small the goal.
choice_data_list: ...Are you really sure about this?
...Is that really okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes. So please, Trainer,
watch over me from the stands.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Witness the princess taking her first new step
in this Debut race.
choice_data_list: ...I'll be watching over you properly!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: (Trainer. I feel so relieved now.)

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(You're unlike anyone I ever met as a child.
A person striving to become a "Legendary Trainer.")

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(Because you're the one who truly believes from the bottom of your heart
that I will become the ideal princess...!)
